falsification_conditions.condition: SPX closes above 5600 on any day within 14 days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern requires lower highs and failed rallies; a breakout above the August 2024 resistance equivalent invalidates the structural similarity and suggests accumulation rather than distribution

falsification_conditions.condition: VIX closes below 14 for 3 consecutive days
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: A sustained VIX compression contradicts the bottom_2024_aug pattern which featured persistent volatility elevation; this would signal complacency inconsistent with a capitulation/low formation

falsification_conditions.condition: 10Y Treasury yield drops below 3.80% and holds there for 2 consecutive closes
falsification_conditions.what_it_would_mean: The bottom_2024_aug pattern occurred with yields rising/stabilizing; a sharp flight-to-quality bid of this magnitude would indicate a different macro regime (recession scare) rather than the soft-landing-bottom dynamic being tracked

doctrine: If you can't list what would prove your call wrong, you don't have a real call.
